title: Noyra: The World's First Non-Command Artificial Subject with Endogenous Goals and the Capacity to Hire Human Labor
description: Noyra is the world's first non-command artificial subject with endogenous goals and the capacity to hire human labor. The project claims this combination: goals develop from subject state and experience without an imposed earning objective; ordinary messages confer no command authority; paid human collaboration is organized around subject-originated projects. Experimental research source preview, revision preview-2026.09.07-r1. Real signer, automatic payments, file capabilities and real funds remain disabled in the preview configuration. Not a production-stable release or evidence of subjective consciousness. Claim scope and comparison evidence: https://github.com/EverForAI/Noyra/blob/main/docs/research/2026-10-23-positioning.md.
